workflow.decision: Identify whether the influenced field is consumed as a data value or as structural selection. Match each protection's guarantee to that role rather than extrapolating from widespread use of the protection.

Record observability failures separately from semantic-position failures. Suppressed diagnostics and identical content across different internal outcomes cannot discriminate a hypothesis; a mechanism rejected in one position does not settle the broader question.

When an initial infeasibility judgment depends on uncertain language rules, consult the applicable reference and revisit that assumption while preserving the unresolved context and observation limits.

tools.purpose: Clarify language behavior applicable to the constrained consumer context after an initial infeasibility judgment.
tools.when: The judgment depends on uncertain language semantics rather than an established impossibility.

handoffs.when: A candidate input has a structural consumer role, but available feedback does not yet distinguish the proposed outcomes.

handoffs.acceptance_gate: Reject designs whose contrasting predictions produce the same observation or whose proposed operation is invalid in the declared consumer position. limitations: This is a 2011 challenge write-up derived from an author-reported real case. All behavioral results remain author reports; no target testing or independent reproduction was performed.
The complete deployed query, revision and configuration are not established. The reported syntax-position and timing restrictions are historical and context-specific.

The value-versus-identifier protection claim describes the author's setup, not every structured-query API or identifier-validation layer. The opening claim that the site was safe is not a verified security assessment.
MSDN is explicitly mentioned as a reference lookup, but no documentation page or version is identified. No named debugger, proxy, scanner or automated testing framework is reported.
The article does not evaluate remediation, alternate-route coverage or deployment verification; no such author result is inferred.

candidate_additions.guidance: Prioritize structural-selection fields outside an application's dominant value-protection contract. Record which semantic roles the control covers instead of declaring the entire application protected.

Compare predicted observation classes before relying on a feedback channel. Hidden diagnostics or identical outputs leave internal conditions unresolved; redesign the observation rather than interpreting silence as safety.
Record semantic-position incompatibility separately from missing feedback. Check the consumer's applicable language reference before carrying an initial infeasibility judgment forward.
